quotations.old_english: Ðé to gerihtrecenne ðæt ðú gesyhst myd ðínes módes eágan
quotations.english: god to direct thee to see God with thy mind's eye

source_text: ge-rihtreccan to direct :-- Ðé to gerihtrecenne ðæt ðú gesyhst myd ðínes módes eágan god to direct thee to see God with thy mind's eye, Shrn. 177, 25.
